# Japan My Number Card Expiry Check

> Free, unofficial checker for when a Japan My Number Card (マイナンバーカード, Individual Number Card) expires and what the holder must do before then. Foreign residents with a period of stay: the card ends on the period-of-stay expiry and is NOT extended automatically by a visa renewal (ordinance art. 27); extend at city hall before that date, up to the 10th birthday after the card was made; one-time extension to expiry + 2 months while a renewal is pending. Japanese, permanent residents, HSP (ii), special permanent residents: 10th / 5th birthday (art. 26), renewal from the day fewer than 3 months remain, new card to the 11th / 6th birthday (art. 29). Also e-certificates, the マイナ保険証 grace and the 特定在留カード (2026-06-14). Rules as of 2026-10-29. Educational, not legal advice; not affiliated with the Digital Agency, J-LIS, ISA or any city office.

Site: https://japan-mynumber-card-check.vercel.app

## Key facts (official sources below)
- Card validity (18+ at issue): to the 10th birthday after the card was made; under 18: 5th birthday. Cards made by 2022-03-31 used age 20 as the line. Feb 29 birthdays → Feb 28 in non-leap years.
- Renewal: from the first day fewer than 3 months remain (expiry 2026-10-01 → from 2026-07-02), free, also after expiry (Digital Agency FAQ Q12). A card made in that window runs to the 11th (6th) birthday.
- Foreign residents with a period of stay: card expires on the period-of-stay expiry (under 18: earlier of that and the 5th birthday). No auto-extension and no reminder. After a renewal / change is granted, extend at city hall BEFORE the card expires (free); otherwise the card lapses and a new card is needed (some cities charge, e.g. Matsudo ¥1,000).
- Renewal pending at expiry: with proof (更新申請中 stamp, online completion email, receipt), the city extends the card once, to expiry + 2 months (end of the special period). Then extend again when the new residence card arrives.
- Becoming PR / HSP (ii) / SPR: the card can be extended to the 10th-birthday date (art. 27(2)(i)).
- 特定在留カード (combined residence card + My Number Card, since 2026-06-14): optional, counter-only. New card from ISA = no city-hall visit. While pending, the My Number function still ends on the original date: extend at city hall before then (ISA Q5-3).
- E-certificates: 5th birthday after issue, never past the card. マイナ保険証 grace after the user certificate expires: to the end of the 3rd month after the expiry month (2026-11-10 → 2027-02-28), eligibility info only.
- PR / HSP (ii) residence card: issued by 2026-06-13 = 7 years; from 2026-06-14 = 10th birthday after issue. Renew at ISA from 3 months before; free.

## API (free, no key, CORS open)

### GET
GET https://japan-mynumber-card-check.vercel.app/api/check?holder=mid_long&birthDate=1992-04-10&cardIssueDate=2024-03-01&residenceExpiry=2026-12-15&renewal=pending&today=2026-10-29
→ verdict "extend_before_expiry", card {expiry "2026-12-15", maxExtendableTo "2033-04-10"}, specialExtension {extendTo "2027-02-15", mustApplyBy "2026-12-15"}, ecert {expiry, renewFrom, status, insuranceGraceEnds "2027-03-31"}, actions[{what, from, by, where, fee}], warnings[], sources, disclaimer

### POST
POST https://japan-mynumber-card-check.vercel.app/api/check
{"holder":"japanese","birthDate":"1985-01-20","cardIssueDate":"2017-02-01","today":"2026-10-29"}
→ verdict "renew_window_open", card.expiry "2027-01-20", card.renewFrom "2026-10-21"

Parameters: holder (mid_long | permanent | hsp2 | spr | japanese; aliases pr, student, work, citizen…), birthDate, cardIssueDate, residenceExpiry (mid_long), renewal (none | pending | granted), newResidenceExpiry (granted), specificCard (true/false), cardExpiry (optional override), ecertExpiry (optional), issuedAsRenewal (optional), residenceCardExpiry (PR / HSP2, optional), today (optional). Never send a My Number itself.

## Disclaimer
Educational date calculator, not legal advice, not affiliated with the Digital Agency, J-LIS, ISA or any city office. The date printed on your card and your city office are what count.
